title_zh: 亞斯納 第 8 章‧肉供與信眾分食
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 31 卷，1887；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
ashem vohû vahishtem astî ... (3). ashaya dadhãmi
hvarethem myazdem haurvata ameretâta gâush hudå
haomemca para-haomemca aêsmãsca baoidhîmca
frasasti ahurahe mazdå ahunahe vairyehe arshuxdhahe vâxsh
dahmayå vanghuyå âfritôish ukhrâi
dâmôish upamanâi haomaheca mãthraheca
ashaonaêca zarathushtrahe, ashaya-nô paiti jamyât!
segments.en:
A blessing is Righteousness (called) the Best.
It is weal; it is weal to this (man),
When toward Righteousness Best there is right.
I offer the Myazda (of the) meat-offering with a complete and
sacred offering; and I offer Haurvatatat (who guards the water),
and Ameretatat (who guards the plants and the wood), and the flesh
of the blessed Kine; and I offer the Haoma and the Haoma-juice,
the wood-billets and the perfume for the praise of Ahura Mazda,
and of the Ahuna-vairya, the veracious word, and for that of the
pious and beneficent Prayer for blessings, and for the redoubted
Curse of the wise, and for the praise of the Haoma, and of the
Mathra of the holy Zarathushtra; and may it come to us with sacred
fullness (to accept and to recompense our gift).
segments.zh:
祝福降於正義，即至善者。
福澤也；福澤於此人也，
當向至善正義而行之時。
我以完全且
神聖的供奉向肉供的邁茲達獻祭；我獻祭胡爾瓦塔特（守護水者），
與阿梅雷塔特（守護植物與木材者），及肉體
祝福牛群的；我獻祭豪麻與豪麻汁，
木柴與香氣以讚頌阿胡拉‧馬茲達，
與阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞、真實之言，以及
虔誠而慈悲的祝福祈禱，與令人敬畏的
智者之詛咒，以讚頌豪麻與
聖查拉圖斯特拉的教言；願它以聖潔之
充滿（接受並償報我們的禮物）。

segments.orig:
(râspî,) hvarata narô aêtem myazdem
ýôi dim hanghâna ashâca frêretica!
segments.en:
(The Ratu speaks.) Eat, O ye men, of this Myazda, the meat-offering,
ye who have deserved it by your righteousness and correctness.
segments.zh: （祭司長言。）男人啊，你們應當吃這密亞茲達，肉祭品，你們以正義與正確而得之者。

segments.orig:
(zôt,) amesha speñta daêne mâzdayasne
vanghavasca vanguhîshca zaothråsca, ýô
aêshva mazdayasnaêshva mazdayasnô aojanô
ashahe râthma jîshtayamnô ýâthwa
gaêthå ashahe merekheñte avi tû dim disyata
ýå apasca urvaråsca zaothråsca.
segments.en:
O ye Bountiful Immortals, and thou, the Mazdayasnian law,
ye just men and just women, and ye Zaothras, whoever among these
Mazdayasnians would call himself a Mazdayasnian desiring to live
in the practice of the liberality of Righteousness [for by sorcery
the settlements of Righteousness are ruined], do ye cause (such
an one) to be (still further) taught, (ye), who are the waters,
the plants, and the Zaothras!
segments.zh: （祭司言。）不朽聖者啊，瑪茲達亞斯納信仰啊，正義的男人與正義的女人啊，祭司啊，凡此瑪茲達亞斯納信徒中，自稱瑪茲達亞斯納人、欲依正義的慷慨行為而生活者〔蓋由妖術，正義的定居地遭毀滅〕，願你等令如此者得更進一步的教誨，願你等──諸水、諸植物與祭司──令其然。

segments.orig:
ýasca aêtaêshãm mazdayasnanãm
perenâyunãm aiwi-zûzuyanãm imã
vacô nôit vîsaiti framrûite aêtãm
â ýâtumanahe jasaiti. ashem vohû vahishtem
astî ... (3 u 4). ýathâ ahû vairyô
... (2)!
segments.en:
And whoever of these Mazdayasnians, adults, when he invokes
with earnestness, does not adhere to these words, and (so) speaks,
he approaches to that (word) of the magician; (but, as against
that magician's word) 'a blessing is Righteousness (called) the
Best.'
segments.zh: 凡此瑪茲達亞斯納信徒中之成人，當其虔誠地祈禱時，不堅守此等言辭，而如此言說者，彼趨近於魔法師之言；然如對彼魔法師之言：正義乃稱為最善者。

segments.orig:
vasasca tû ahura-mazda ushtâca xshaêsha
havanãm dâmanãm, vasô âpô
vasô urvarå vasô vîspa vohû ashacithra
xshayamnem ashavanem dâyata axshayamnem drvañtem.
segments.en:
May'st Thou, O Ahura Mazda! reign at Thy will, and with a
saving rule over Thine own creatures, and render Ye the holy (man)
also a sovereign at his will over waters, and over plants, and
over all the clean and sacred (creatures) which contain the seed
of Righteousness. Strip ye the wicked of all power!
segments.zh: 願汝，阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊，以汝之意願而統治，並以拯救性的統治治理汝之造物。願汝等亦令聖者為其意願之上主，統治諸水、諸植物，與所有含有正義之種子的潔淨聖潔造物。剝去邪惡者之一切權力。

segments.orig:
vasô-xshathrô hyât ashava, avasô-xshathrô
hyât drvå gatô hamistô nizhberetô
haca speñtahe mainyêush dâmabyô varatô
avasô-xshathrô.
segments.en:
Absolute in power may the holy be, bereft of all free choice
the wicked ! Gone (may he be), met as foe, carried out from the
creatures of Spenta Mainyu, hemmed in without power over any wish!
segments.zh: 聖者在權力中絕對，邪惡者在自由抉擇中無力。彼已遠去，作為敵人相遇，自斯彭塔‧曼紐之造物中被運出，被禁錮無力於任何願望。

segments.orig:
haxshaya azemcit ýô zarathushtrô fratemã
nmânanãmca vîsãmca zañtunãmca
dah'yunãmca ainghå daênayå anumatayaêca
anuxtayaêca anvarshtayaêca ýâ âhûirish
zarathushtrish.
segments.en:
I will incite, even I who am Zarathushtra, the heads of the
houses, villages, Zantus, and provinces, to the careful following
of this Religion which is that of Ahura, and according to Zarathushtra,
in their thoughts, their words, and their deeds.
segments.zh: 我，查拉圖斯特拉，將激勵家族的首領、村落、州郡與省份，謹慎遵循此信仰，乃阿胡拉之信仰，依查拉圖斯特拉，在其思想、言辭與行為中。

segments.orig:
(râspî,) ravasca hvâthremca âfrînâmi
vîspayå ashaonô stôish, ãzasca
duzhâthremca âfrînâmi vîspayå
drvatô stôish!
segments.en:
I pray for the freedom and glory of the entire existence of
the holy (man) while I bless it, and I pray for the repression
and shame of the entire existence of the wicked.
segments.zh: （祭司長言。）我祝福聖者全體生存之自由與榮耀時而祈禱之，我祈禱邪惡者全體生存之壓抑與羞恥。

segments.orig:
ashem vohû vahishtem astî ... (3). haomahe ashavazanghô
xshnaothra ýasnâica vahmâica xshnaothrâica
frasastayaêca. (zôt,) ýathâ ahû
vairyô zaotâ frâ-mê mrûtê,
(râspî,) ýathâ ahû vairyô
ýô zaotâ frâ-mê mrûtê,
(zôt,) athâ ratush ashâtcît haca frâ
ashava vîdhvå mraotû!!
segments.en:
Ashem Vohu ... (3).
Propitiation to Haoma who brings righteousness (to us) for 
sacrifice, homage, propitiation, and for praise. (The Zaotar?)
As the Ahu to be (revered and) chosen, the Zaotar speaks forth
to me. (The Ratu.) As an Ahu to be (revered and) chosen, the Zaotar
speaks forth to me. (The Zaotar.) So let the Ratu from his Righteousness,
holy and learned, speak forth!
 THE HOM YASHT

segments.zh: 阿舍姆‧沃胡……（3）。向豪麻致敬，其帶來正義於我等，為祭祀、致敬、祈禱與讚美。（祭司？）如應受尊敬與選擇之阿胡，祭司向我言說。（祭司長。）如應受尊敬與選擇之阿胡，祭司向我言說。（祭司。）願祭司長從其正義，聖潔而學識淵博，向前言說。
